Bluffdale ACM Chapter Hosts Summer Tech Talk 2026: “Human + Machine: AI in Everyday Engineering”

BLUFFDALE, UT — The Bluffdale ACM Chapter held its Summer Tech Talk 2026 on Saturday, August 1, running the evening in a hybrid format from its venue at 14895 S. Noell Nelson Drive in Bluffdale. Six speakers from Amazon Web Services, US Bank, UnitedHealth, and Blue Ribbon Global Technologies present
